codeReview.summary: Implementation correctly converts all static mutable state in SpeechBubbleManager and VoiceAssignmentManager to instance fields, adds null-safe Current accessors, updates callers in TTSManager and SocialInteractions.cs, and leaves NegotiationManager untouched. All validation criteria are met. The lock object is now an instance field. All static methods that access mutable state route through Current with null guards. Build and 24 tests pass.

issues.description: IsConversationActive reads activeConversations.Contains() without taking queueLock, while all mutations to activeConversations happen under queueLock. This is a pre-existing thread-safety concern (not introduced by this change) but worth noting — HashSet.Contains is not thread-safe if concurrent writes are possible.

GameComponentTick() calls static EndConversation(convId) internally, which re-fetches Current from the game. Since GameComponentTick() IS the current instance, this is a minor inefficiency (double component lookup) but functionally correct and matches the codebase's established pattern.
